newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GENCOR HITS NEW HIGH AFTER BILLITON NEWS.
newsitem.headline: GENCOR HITS NEW HIGH AFTER BILLITON NEWS.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Gencor Ltd rose to a new year high on Wednesday after the firm announced it was listing a new base metals company Billiton Plc in London and raising more than $1 billion through a global equity placement.
The firm's shares were up 160 cents to to a new year high of 20.70 rand.

"Billiton will be one of the largest and lowest cost producers of aluminium and the leading producer of ferroalloys, the world's largest exporter of thermal coal and a leading source of titanium minerals," the company said in a statement.

In a wave of news on the firm Gencor also said it expected an improvement in earnings in the current quarter to end-June and continued to expect similar second-half results to those achieved in the first half.

"I am permitted to say that the current quarter will be better than the last quarter, and that I can see no reason to change the forecast that I made at the half-year regarding Gencor's results for the full 1997 financial year," chairman Brian Gilbertson told a news conference.
Earlier in the morning the firm sealed a deal with Australia's QNI Ltd to merge their nickel operations.
